=== Header ===
Derived mechanically from the ORM model by `gnd extract` (R-08").
Constraint-blind by specification: object types, reference schemes,
fact-type readings and primitive shapes only — no constraint
sentences, no modality, no provenance. Hand-authoring this file is
banned; regenerate it with `gnd extract MODEL --out DIR`.

=== Object Types ===
Employee is identified by EmployeeId.
EmployeeId is a value of type Integer.
EmployeeName is a value of type String.
Gender is a value of type String.
Department is identified by DepartmentCode.
DepartmentCode is a value of type String.
Project is identified by ProjectName.
ProjectName is a value of type String.
Salary is identified by a value in USD (Money).
Hours is a value of type Integer.
CalendarDate is a value of type Date.
Assignment is identified by the combination of employee (in fact type assignment_of_employee) and project (in fact type assignment_on_project).
ContractorEmployee is a kind of Employee, inheriting the reference of Employee.
PermanentEmployee is a kind of Employee, inheriting the reference of Employee.

=== Fact Types ===
Employee has EmployeeName
  - employee: Employee (Integer)
  - name: EmployeeName (String)

Employee has Gender
  - employee: Employee (Integer)
  - gender: Gender (String)

Employee earns Salary
  - employee: Employee (Integer)
  - salary: Salary

Employee (subordinate) reports to Employee (manager)
  - subordinate: Employee (Integer)
  - manager: Employee (Integer)

Employee works on Project
  - employee: Employee (Integer)
  - project: Project (String)

Employee leads Project
  - employee: Employee (Integer)
  - project: Project (String)

Employee heads Department
  - employee: Employee (Integer)
  - department: Department (String)

Assignment is of Employee
  - assignment: Assignment
  - employee: Employee (Integer)

Assignment is on Project
  - assignment: Assignment
  - project: Project (String)

Assignment has logged Hours
  - assignment: Assignment
  - hours: Hours (Integer)

Assignment has overtime Hours
  - assignment: Assignment
  - hours: Hours (Integer)

Project ran from CalendarDate (start) to CalendarDate (end)
  - project: Project (String)
  - start: CalendarDate (Date)
  - end: CalendarDate (Date)

Employee is full-time
  - employee: Employee (Integer)

Employee is part-time
  - employee: Employee (Integer)

Employee is active
  - employee: Employee (Integer)

Employee is terminated
  - employee: Employee (Integer)
